skilled_jockey.name: Skilled Jockey
skilled_jockey.narrative_identity: The ship responds to the pilot's hands like an extension of their body. What looks reckless to passengers is precision to the pilot.

galaxy_mapper.name: Galaxy Mapper
galaxy_mapper.narrative_identity: Hyperspace lanes are not abstractions to this pilot. They are roads walked a hundred times, each one remembered by the way the ship shudders at the transition point.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.narrative_identity: Movement without sound. Presence without notice. The character has learned to occupy space without disturbing it.

street_smarts.name: Street Smarts
street_smarts.narrative_identity: The underworld has its own geography. This character reads it the way cartographers read terrain — instinctively, without having to think about why the alley narrows or the lights go out.

bypass_security.name: Bypass Security

effects.description: The character has trained knowledge of security systems. The GM should offer choices involving security bypass more readily.

bypass_security.narrative_identity: Locks are puzzles with known solutions. Security systems are designed by people who think like designers. This character thinks like a thief.

dead_to_rights.name: Dead to Rights
dead_to_rights.narrative_identity: Every shot is deliberate. The character does not spray and pray. They pick their moment, pick their target, and make it count.

grit.name: Grit
grit.narrative_identity: Endurance that does not announce itself. The character simply keeps going past the point where others stop.

toughened.name: Toughened
toughened.narrative_identity: The body learns to take damage. Not painlessly, but efficiently. Bruises that would have stopped the character a year ago are now absorbed without breaking stride.

rapid_recovery.name: Rapid Recovery
rapid_recovery.narrative_identity: Rest comes faster now. The character has learned to let go of tension the way a sailor sleeps through storms.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.narrative_identity: The character moves before they think. Instinct sharpened by years of being shot at.

quick_strike.name: Quick Strike
quick_strike.narrative_identity: The first move is the one that matters. This character reads the moment a situation turns violent and acts before the other side finishes deciding.

defensive_driving.name: Defensive Driving
defensive_driving.narrative_identity: Flying defensively is not about timidity. It is about knowing which vectors the enemy cannot reach and putting the ship there before they fire.

side_step.name: Side Step
side_step.narrative_identity: The character shifts weight before the shot arrives. Not a dramatic dive — a half-step, a lean, the kind of movement that comes from knowing exactly how far a blaster bolt spreads at twenty meters.

tricky_target.name: Tricky Target
tricky_target.narrative_identity: The ship does not fly in straight lines. It jinks, rolls, and slides through firing solutions like water through a grate.

convincing_demeanor.name: Convincing Demeanor
convincing_demeanor.narrative_identity: The character's lies function as social tools — not crude deception but performed sincerity, tactical empathy, the ability to become whoever the situation requires.

black_market_contacts.name: Black Market Contacts

effects.description: Has reliable black market contacts for acquiring illegal or restricted equipment. GM should offer acquisition choices when contextually appropriate.

black_market_contacts.narrative_identity: The character knows who to call. Not friends — professionals. The kind of people who have what you need and do not ask why you need it.

full_throttle.name: Full Throttle

effects.description: The character can push a vehicle to its maximum speed as a deliberate action. The GM should offer speed-related choices in vehicle scenes that other characters would not have.

full_throttle.narrative_identity: There is a point past which most pilots ease off the throttle. This character has never found it.

lets_ride.name: Let's Ride

effects.description: The character can mount or enter a vehicle as an incidental. In escape or chase scenes, the GM should allow immediate vehicle access without delay.

lets_ride.narrative_identity: The cockpit is home. Getting into it is not an action — it is a reflex. The character is already moving before the hatch finishes opening.

shortcut.name: Shortcut

effects.description: The character can find faster routes. In chase sequences, the GM can offer shortcut choices that other characters would not have access to.

shortcut.narrative_identity: Every station has its hidden geometry. Maintenance corridors, service lifts, the gaps between what the architects intended and what the residents discovered. This character knows them.

quick_draw.name: Quick Draw

effects.description: The character draws and holsters weapons as an incidental. In tense standoff scenes, the GM should reflect this readiness.

quick_draw.narrative_identity: The weapon appears. Not drawn — appeared. The motion is too practiced to have a visible beginning.

indistinguishable.name: Indistinguishable

effects.description: The character is forgettable by design. NPCs have difficulty recalling specific details about them. The GM should make identification and pursuit harder when this character is trying to disappear into a crowd.

indistinguishable.narrative_identity: Average height, average build, average face. The kind of person you look at and immediately forget. This is not an accident — it is a skill refined over years of wanting to be invisible.

natural_pilot.name: Natural Pilot

effects.narrative_prompt: A correction so small and so fast it might have been the ship itself deciding to live.

natural_pilot.narrative_identity: Some pilots fly. This one breathes it. When everything goes wrong, something deeper than training takes over.

natural_charmer.name: Natural Charmer

effects.narrative_prompt: A moment of recovery — the character finds the right angle just when everything seemed lost.

natural_charmer.narrative_identity: Words are this character's weapon. When a conversation turns hostile, they find the phrase that turns it back — not through intelligence but through an instinct for what people need to hear.

second_chances.name: Second Chances

effects.narrative_prompt: Not over. Not yet. The character reaches for something they did not know they had.

second_chances.narrative_identity: Failure is not the end. It is the moment before the recovery — the breath between falling and catching yourself.

dedication.name: Dedication
dedication.narrative_identity: A fundamental shift in who the character is. Not what they can do, but what they are made of.
